title: Channel
description: One messaging channel through which the user reaches Progena (for example Telegram): the payload of a channel:<id> document. The backend runs the channel type's adapter from these settings and reconnects it whenever the document changes. Credentials are references or ciphertext only; secret values are never stored in plain text.

id.description: Channel id; the document key is channel:<id>.

enabled.description: Whether the backend runs this channel.

settings.description: Non-secret settings defined and validated by the channel type.

credentials.description: Secret references keyed by credential name: an environment variable name, or ciphertext encrypted by the backend.
